current: Current view stacks the latest posted report for each cycle: Transition Phase 3a (Apr 2026), 2024 Phase 2b (Jul 2026) and 2025 Phase 1 (Jun 2026). Most Transition projects moved to ERIS in Phases 2–3a, which removed the large shared 500 kV upgrades; open the Transition history tabs to see the MW that originally triggered them.
transition-ph1: Phase 1 is the full NRIS picture before any conversions: 11 of 13 projects shared the two 120-mile Sitgreaves 500 kV lines (about $358M each).
transition-ph3a: After Q347, Q352, Q497, Q538 and Q539 moved to ERIS, only 925 MW of NRIS remained and the shared 500 kV upgrades fell away. Q422–Q424 stay NRIS with no system upgrade cost.
cluster-2026: Requests from the 2026 cluster window (Apr–May 2026) in this area, from the 13 Oct 2026 queue posting. No study results are posted yet. Q637 and Q643 (750 MW NRIS each) request the not-yet-built Sitgreaves 500 kV station, the same station the Transition and 2025 clusters priced at $60M and $150M.
serial: Serial-process projects ahead of the cluster. Q318–Q320 (3.5 GW wind at Four Corners 345 kV, suspended) carry the new Four Corners–Moenkopi #2 and Cholla–Pinnacle Peak 500 kV lines in their 2023 Facilities Studies. Q311’s share of those lines is deferred until Q318–Q320 start construction. The Cholla #6 transformer replacement was dropped once Cholla 3 and 4 were assumed retired.
full: Serial projects (top) still hold about $1.9B of corridor upgrades on paper: a new Four Corners–Moenkopi #2 500 kV line and a new Cholla–Pinnacle Peak 500 kV line, with Q318–Q320 suspended and Q311 deferred. The Transition Cluster’s Sitgreaves–Pinnacle Peak line targets the same corridor, and the 2025 cluster’s Q609 now carries a $1.0B version of it alone.
2025-ph1: Q609 (500 MW NRIS) alone triggers a second Sitgreaves–Pinnacle Peak 500 kV line at $1.0B plus a $150M Sitgreaves 500 kV station; earliest in-service Q3 2037.
